events.name: The White Walkers Return
events.description: A Night's Watch ranging party is attacked north of the Wall by creatures long thought myth. One survivor flees south and is executed by Eddard Stark as a deserter — the first warning the realm ignores.

events.name: The King Rides North
events.description: King Robert Baratheon arrives at Winterfell to offer Eddard Stark the position of Hand of the King. The Stark family is split between north and south — the beginning of everything.

events.name: Bran is Pushed from the Tower
events.description: Bran Stark witnesses Cersei and Jaime Lannister together, and Jaime pushes him from the window. The boy survives but loses the use of his legs — and a war is seeded in his mother's grief.

events.name: Jon Snow Takes the Black
events.description: Jon Snow rides north to join the Night's Watch, beginning his journey from bastard to the most consequential figure in the war against the dead. He meets Tyrion Lannister on the road.

events.name: Daenerys Weds Khal Drogo
events.description: Viserys sells his sister across the Narrow Sea to a Dothraki warlord. Daenerys begins the transformation from possession to khaleesi — the first steps of an arc that will reshape the world.

events.name: Eddard Discovers the Truth
events.description: Lord Stark uncovers that Joffrey Baratheon is not Robert's son but the product of Lannister incest. He confronts Cersei, who has him arrested. The realm cracks along its foundations.

events.name: Execution of Lord Eddard Stark
events.description: Before the Great Sept of Baelor, Eddard Stark confesses to treason he did not commit — and Joffrey orders his execution anyway. The shock reverberates across the Seven Kingdoms and ends any illusion that honor is rewarded.

events.name: Daenerys Walks into the Fire
events.description: On the Dothraki Sea, Daenerys Targaryen places herself in the flames of her husband's funeral pyre. She emerges unharmed, cradling three newborn dragons — the first born in over a century. The world changed that night.

events.name: Five Kings Lay Claim
events.description: Robb Stark, Stannis Baratheon, Renly Baratheon, Joffrey Baratheon, and Balon Greyjoy all claim the throne or independence. The Seven Kingdoms shatter into open war.

events.name: Tyrion Becomes Hand of the King
events.description: Tywin Lannister sends Tyrion to King's Landing to serve as Hand of the King in his absence. For the first time, someone competent holds the position since Ned Stark's death.

events.name: Death of Renly Baratheon
events.description: Renly Baratheon is murdered by a shadow creature born of Melisandre's power — the largest army in the field vanishing in a single night. His lords scatter to Stannis or home.

events.name: Theon Seizes Winterfell
events.description: Theon Greyjoy captures Winterfell with a small force, executing Ser Rodrik in a moment of terrible overreach. He cannot hold it, but the psychological wound to Robb Stark's campaign proves fatal.

events.name: Daenerys in Qarth
events.description: Daenerys seeks ships and allies in the rich city of Qarth, losing her dragons briefly to the warlocks of the House of the Undying. She reclaims them with fire and begins understanding what she is.

events.name: The Battle of Blackwater
events.description: Stannis Baratheon's fleet is destroyed by the wildfire chain in Blackwater Bay. Tyrion Lannister's tactical brilliance, Tywin's timely arrival, and the Tyrells save King's Landing and Joffrey's reign.

events.name: Jon Snow Beyond the Wall
events.description: Jon Snow's ranging party reaches the Fist of the First Men as Mance Rayder's army of wildlings prepares to march south. The scale of the threat becomes undeniable.

events.name: The Brotherhood Without Banners
events.description: Beric Dondarrion and his brotherhood hold the Riverlands against all sides, resurrected repeatedly by the Lord of Light. Arya watches a man die and return six times — her first encounter with powers beyond human understanding.

events.name: Daenerys Liberates Astapor
events.description: Daenerys acquires the Unsullied by tricking the slavers — buying them with a dragon, then ordering the dragon to burn the owner. Eight thousand Unsullied march out of Astapor as free men who choose to serve her.

events.name: Jaime Lannister Loses His Hand
events.description: Captured by Locke on Roose Bolton's orders, Jaime Lannister's sword hand is severed. The finest swordsman of his generation is unmade in a moment — and forced to rebuild himself from nothing.

events.name: Jon Infiltrates the Wildlings
events.description: Jon Snow spends months beyond the Wall with Mance Rayder's army, falling in love with Ygritte and learning the true scale of the Free Folk threat. He kills Qhorin Halfhand to maintain his cover.

events.name: Daenerys Takes Meereen
events.description: Daenerys liberates the slave city of Meereen, crucifying the Great Masters whose roads were lined with slave children pointing toward the city. She decides to rule rather than sail immediately for Westeros.

events.name: The Red Wedding
events.description: Robb Stark, his pregnant wife Talisa, and Catelyn Stark are massacred at the Twins by Walder Frey and Roose Bolton — the most catastrophic violation of guest right in living memory. The Young Wolf is dead. The war in the north is over.

events.name: Bran Crosses the Wall
events.description: Bran Stark and his companions cross the Wall at Castle Black while Jon Snow returns from the wildlings. They travel in opposite directions — toward the most dangerous truth in the world.

events.name: The Purple Wedding
events.description: King Joffrey Baratheon dies at his own wedding feast, poisoned mid-celebration by Lady Olenna Tyrell with a gem from Sansa Stark's necklace. Cersei accuses Tyrion. The realm celebrates in private.

events.name: Arya and the Hound
events.description: Arya Stark and Sandor Clegane travel the Riverlands together — a road trip through post-war devastation that functions as the show's most compressed moral education. Arya adds names to her list. The Hound adds complexities.

events.name: Trial by Combat — The Viper vs. The Mountain
events.description: Prince Oberyn Martell fights Ser Gregor Clegane as Tyrion's champion. He almost wins. Wanting confession more than victory, he circles one step too long. The Mountain crushes his skull. Tyrion is condemned.

events.name: The Battle of Castle Black
events.description: One hundred brothers of the Night's Watch hold Castle Black against Mance Rayder's hundred thousand wildlings — including the Mance's army attacking from the north and Tormund from the south. Jon Snow leads the defense through a night of desperate fighting.

events.name: Lysa Arryn's Death
events.description: Littlefinger pushes Lysa Arryn through the Moon Door, eliminating his last collaborator and consolidating control of the Vale. The woman who poisoned Jon Arryn on his behalf dies by his hand.

events.name: Tyrion Kills Tywin
events.description: Tyrion, freed by Jaime, finds Shae in his father's bed. He strangles her. Then he finds Tywin on the privy and drives two crossbow bolts through the most powerful man in Westeros. The Lannister golden age is over.

events.name: Bran Reaches the Three-Eyed Raven
events.description: Bran Stark and his companions reach the cave north of the Wall where the Three-Eyed Raven has waited for a thousand years. Jojen Reed dies in its shadow. Bran's transformation begins.

events.name: Cersei and the High Sparrow
events.description: Cersei arms the Faith Militant to destroy the Tyrells and is then trapped by her own weapon. Her arrest and subsequent walk of atonement — naked, jeered through King's Landing — is the realm's most brutal statement on the impermanence of power.

events.name: Tyrion Meets Daenerys in Meereen
events.description: Tyrion Lannister, having traveled across the Narrow Sea via crate, is brought before Daenerys Targaryen in Meereen. Two of the cleverest people in the world take stock of each other and decide to collaborate.

events.name: Stannis Burns Shireen
events.description: Stannis Baratheon, his army frozen and starving, burns his own daughter Shireen at Melisandre's urging to pray for victory. The gods appear to respond. The humanity inside Stannis does not survive the answer.

events.name: Hardhome
events.description: Jon Snow evacuates wildlings from Hardhome as the White Walkers attack. Thousands of the dead rise. Jon kills a White Walker with Longclaw — Valyrian steel destroys them. The Night King raises the fallen with a gesture. The stakes of the real war are finally clear.

events.name: Daenerys Rides Drogon
events.description: Surrounded in the fighting pits of Meereen, Daenerys reaches out and Drogon descends. She rides him for the first time — into the sky, beyond the reach of her enemies, a queen becoming something more.

events.name: Murder of Jon Snow
events.description: Jon Snow is stabbed repeatedly by his own brothers of the Night's Watch — Alliser Thorne, Bowen Marsh, and finally Olly — in the courtyard of Castle Black. 'For the Watch.' For the night, he is dead.

events.name: Arya Becomes No One
events.description: Arya Stark enters the House of Black and White in Braavos and begins training with the Faceless Men. She learns to wear other faces, to kill without attachment — and ultimately to choose her own name over anonymity.

events.name: Resurrection of Jon Snow
events.description: Melisandre performs a ritual over Jon Snow's body. Nothing happens. She leaves. Jon Snow gasps. He rises from the dead, remembering only cold darkness, and nothing in the realm is quite the same after.

events.name: Bran Learns of Ned's Promise
events.description: Bran's visions reach the Tower of Joy, where young Eddard Stark breaks down the door to find his dying sister Lyanna. Her whispered words — and his promise — change everything the realm thought it knew.

events.name: Arya Kills the Waif
events.description: Arya Stark defeats the Waif in the dark and reclaims her name. She is not No One. She is Arya Stark of Winterfell. And she is going home.

events.name: Battle of the Bastards
events.description: Jon Snow and Ramsay Bolton clash before the walls of Winterfell. Ramsay's superior tactics and Rickon Stark's murder nearly destroy Jon's forces — until the knights of the Vale arrive. Ramsay is captured and fed to his own hounds.

events.name: The Destruction of the Great Sept
events.description: Cersei ignites caches of wildfire beneath the Great Sept of Baelor, killing the High Sparrow, Margaery Tyrell, Loras, Mace Tyrell, Kevan Lannister, and hundreds more. Tommen watches from a window and steps off the ledge.

events.name: Arya Kills Walder Frey
events.description: Arya Stark, wearing another man's face, serves Walder Frey a pie that contains his sons, then opens his throat. The Freys who hosted the Red Wedding are never safe again. The North remembers.

events.name: Cersei Crowns Herself Queen
events.description: With Tommen dead, Cersei Lannister walks into the throne room in black armor and is crowned Queen of the Seven Kingdoms. The last Lannister standing. The throne she spent twenty years coveting, now hers.

events.name: Daenerys Arrives at Dragonstone
events.description: After a lifetime of exile, Daenerys Targaryen sets foot on Dragonstone — the castle of her birth. She touches the stone walls and walks the Painted Table where her ancestor once planned conquest. She has come home.

events.name: Jon Snow Bends the Knee
events.description: Jon Snow travels to Dragonstone to ask Daenerys Targaryen for access to the dragonglass mines beneath the island. Fire and ice meet for the first time. Neither is unchanged.

events.name: Battle of the Goldroad
events.description: Daenerys and Drogon attack the Lannister army's supply train returning from Highgarden. The Dothraki sweep. Drogon burns. Bronn wounds Drogon with a ballista bolt. Jaime Lannister nearly dies. The war's terms change fundamentally.

events.name: Littlefinger's Trial and Execution
events.description: Arya, Sansa, and Bran Stark turn the tables on Petyr Baelish — the man who set every catastrophe of the past six years in motion. Arya cuts his throat with his own Valyrian dagger. The ladder burns.

events.name: Viserion Falls Beyond the Wall
events.description: Jon Snow's party is surrounded on a frozen lake beyond the Wall. The Night King hurls an ice spear. Viserion crashes through the ice, dead before he sinks. Daenerys's world narrows sharply.

events.name: Jon's True Parentage Confirmed
events.description: Samwell Tarly's discovery in a High Septon's diary, combined with Bran's visions of the Tower of Joy, confirms what Howland Reed has known for years: Jon Snow is Aegon Targaryen, trueborn son of Rhaegar and Lyanna Stark.

events.name: The Wall Falls at Eastwatch
events.description: Viserion — resurrected, blue-eyed, breathing freezing death — destroys the Wall at Eastwatch-by-the-Sea. Eight thousand years of protection crumble in seconds. The Long Night begins.

title: The Long Night & The Iron Throne

events.name: Jon's Parentage Revealed
events.description: Jon Snow learns his true name and parentage from Samwell Tarly in the crypts of Winterfell. He is not a bastard. He is Aegon Targaryen. He is Daenerys's nephew. And he has the stronger claim.

events.name: Jaime Lannister Knights Brienne
events.description: On the eve of the Battle of Winterfell, Jaime Lannister kneels before Brienne of Tarth and knights her — a woman who has been the finest knight of her generation without the title. The moment silences a room.

events.name: The Long Night — Battle of Winterfell
events.description: The armies of the living meet the dead at Winterfell. The Dothraki flame goes out in seconds. The dead breach the walls. Defeat seems certain until Arya Stark leaps from the darkness — a single dagger, a single moment.

events.name: Arya Kills the Night King
events.description: Arya Stark, applying everything Syrio Forel and the Faceless Men taught her, drops the catspaw dagger into her off hand mid-fall and drives it through the Night King's armor. He shatters. The Army of the Dead falls. The Long Night ends.

events.name: The Burning of King's Landing
events.description: Daenerys Targaryen, grief-maddened and isolated, hears the bells of surrender and burns King's Landing anyway. Drogon scours the streets. Tens of thousands die. The Mother of Dragons becomes the Destroyer of Cities.

events.name: Death of Daenerys Targaryen
events.description: Jon Snow, knowing what she has become and what she will do next, embraces Daenerys in the throne room and drives his blade through her heart. Drogon melts the Iron Throne and flies east with her body. The Targaryen dynasty ends.

events.name: Bran Stark Crowned King
events.description: The great lords of Westeros choose Bran Stark — the Three-Eyed Raven — as King of the Six Kingdoms, the first elected monarch in Westerosi history. Sansa secures the North's independence. Arya sails west. Jon goes beyond the Wall. The age of dragons is over.

events.name: Sansa Crowned Queen in the North
events.description: Sansa Stark is crowned Queen in the North — the first in centuries to hold that title — having secured the North's independence when every other kingdom bent the knee. The girl who wanted to be a southern queen became the woman who needed no throne but her own.
